text: Reef, the Saudi fragrance brand (Reef Perfumes), is controlled by the Al Majed brothers: its UK-registered company Reef Perfumes Ltd lists Abdulaziz Bader Al Majed, Faisal Bader Al Majed and Fahad Bader Al Majed as persons with significant control, each holding more than 25% but not more than 50% of its shares; Fahad Al Majed is Reef Group's CEO.
short: Reef Perfumes is controlled by three Al Majed brothers (25-50% each per UK Companies House).
